observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT
Safety: CAUTION
Issues: The image is a lateral chest radiograph marked “LT LAT,” which indicates a left lateral projection, not a left-sided effusion; a lateral view alone cannot reliably lateralize a small pleural effusion to right versus left, so option B is not verifiable from the provided image alone; the risk text itself notes conflicting outputs and lack of confirmation of right-sided blunting.
Suggestion: Confirm the side with a frontal PA/AP view or decubitus view before accepting “small right pleural effusion”; if only the lateral view is available, report the side as indeterminate.
